g.text: Two-dimensional photonic-crystal slab → regional Floquet model
Actual Legume geometry, fields and complex radiation channels; no library modifications
Filled blue: identity connected to Γ; open blue: candidate only. Status squares: green = solved frozen model,
orange = radiation-window refusal, red = unverified identity. 40 static points, 12 identity-supported, 4 model solves.
This validates the integration; it does not certify a complete open band structure, BIC, EP or topology.
